I couldn't find anything in the FastAPI docs about centering a div with CSS. That's a general front-end styling question, and FastAPI is a Python backend framework, so its documentation doesn't cover CSS layout.

The closest material I have is about self-hosting the docs UI files. Self-hosting the JavaScript and CSS could be useful if, for example, you need your app to keep working even while offline, without open Internet access, or in a local network.[1] That covers serving the Swagger UI and ReDoc files, not writing your own CSS.

For centering techniques, check a CSS reference such as MDN Web Docs. Searching for "CSS flexbox centering" or "CSS grid place-items" should get you there. If you want to serve your own CSS files from a FastAPI app, look up "Static Files" in the FastAPI docs.
